description: A6 language rule (BI-PF-0395) enforcing the LOCKED delivery baseline (BI-PF-0387/0388): new shipped/sensitive logic must land in Go; existing shipped Python stays compiled (edits allowed, new modules blocked); build-time tooling may stay Python; Go-backed capabilities are exposed by Go API services (no Python<->Go bridge) with thin Python routes, per ADR-0007/ADR-0008. READ by core/change_policy.py (single reader); enforced by scripts/dev/language_rule_check.py (author-time + precheck). Roots are reviewed config - changing them is a governance change.

edit_growth._doc: BI-PF-1338: catch LARGE new logic added by EDITING an existing shipped .py (the new-file rule alone is bypassable via edits). Flag when a changed shipped .py adds new logic units (def/class/branches) AND grows by >= threshold net lines (sensitive roots use the lower bar). 'allow' lists governed exemptions.
